From: logan_wright@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Need options for mid-cycle 30% top-up and proration

Hi Sahil —

Thanks for the heads-up and the forecast. Below are three pragmatic options we commonly use for mid-contract growth; I included the immediate billing implications and the commercial tradeoffs.

1) Pro-rata invoice for immediate top-up
   - We apply the 30% capacity increase immediately. The incremental charge is prorated for the remainder of your current billing period and invoiced on the next invoice.
   - No change to renewal date (no co-term).
   - Discount: standard commercial uplift discount is 0% for one-off top-ups; we can offer a 5% uplift credit if you commit to maintaining the higher commit for at least two billing cycles.

2) Voucher-style credit + smoothing
   - We issue a voucher/usage credit that covers the next two monthly surges (you draw down as needed). This smooths invoicing.
   - Voucher value is based on expected incremental usage; invoicing for the voucher happens up front.
   - Discount: 7% if voucher is purchased as a single prepayment for the quarter.

3) Formalize to higher committed tier + co-term at renewal
   - Upgrade the committed capacity now and align renewal to a new 12-month term at the higher tier.
   - Proration applies for transition month; thereafter normal rate.
   - Discount: scalable — 10% on committed base if you take the higher tier through renewal and sign an amendment.

Attached is a quick model showing the invoice impact across the three options. I'd suggest voucher-style if you want predictable invoices and formalizing to the higher tier if you're confident the usage is sustained.

Next steps: Ben can price a clean amendment and Marissa can draft a short SOW. If procurement wants the DocuSign-ready SOW, we can push that within 48 hours.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Neurolytics_Topup_Model.xlsx

Sahil — quick pricing clarity from my side:

- If Neurolytics does a one-time pro-rata top-up today: list incremental price (no uplift discount).
- If you pre-pay a quarterly voucher (option 2): we can offer 7% off the voucher line. Voucher can be drawn down across teams as you need.
- If you move to a higher committed tier and co-term at renewal (option 3): 10% discount on the renewed committed base; we can also include a one-time onboarding credit of $5k toward two weeks of priority support during ramp.

Also, a practical note on invoices: procurement asked for line-item detail (previously they had an issue matching top-up items). We will include a separate invoice line called "Top-up: May 2027 — Pro-rated" plus a short description so their AP can match easily.

Happy to run numbers against your forecast — if you drop in the month-by-month numbers I can send a redline showing total cost across the next 12 months for each option.
